# spaceman approval-policy

Operations that need a person's approval.

Aliases: `approval-policies`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman approval-policy create`](#spaceman-approval-policy-create) | Make an operation need approval |
| [`spaceman approval-policy delete`](#spaceman-approval-policy-delete) | Remove a policy (approvals it produced stay usable until they expire) |
| [`spaceman approval-policy get`](#spaceman-approval-policy-get) | Show an approval policy |
| [`spaceman approval-policy list`](#spaceman-approval-policy-list) | Approval policies |

## spaceman approval-policy create

Make an operation need approval.

OPERATION is spaceman.&lt;tool&gt; (a built-in agent tool) or mcp.&lt;server&gt;.&lt;tool&gt; (a gateway tool); a prefix ending in .* covers several.

```sh
spaceman approval-policy create <operation> [flags]
```

API: `create-approval-policy` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--note` | string |  | note |
| `--request-ttl-seconds` | integer |  | how long a request waits for a decision |
| `--space` | string |  | only in this space (ID or slug; default every space) |
| `--uses` | integer |  | how many calls one approval allows |
| `--valid-seconds` | integer |  | how long an approval stays valid |

## spaceman approval-policy delete

Remove a policy (approvals it produced stay usable until they expire).

```sh
spaceman approval-policy delete <policy> [flags]
```

API: `delete-approval-policy` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman approval-policy get

Show an approval policy.

```sh
spaceman approval-policy get <policy> [flags]
```

API: `get-approval-policy` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman approval-policy list

Approval policies.

```sh
spaceman approval-policy list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-approval-policies` ([HTTP API](../api)).
